propositions: The review-bot ASGI lifespan in tests inherits the production 1200-second shutdown drain timeout, causing unit tests to hang or perform background reconciliation and snapshot cleanup.
Test fixture _bound_review_bot_shutdown_drain sets SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1.0 globally for all tests and registers a real_reconcile_loop marker for opt-in production behavior.

Module-autouse fixture _safe_review_bot_lifespan_defaults stubs reconcile.reconcile_loop and rebar._snapshot.start_background_janitor in ordinary tests, with specific tests retaining fault-injection or observable fakes.
test_lifespan_is_safe_by_default_without_per_test_stubs exercises TestClient against the real lifespan without per-test stubs and asserts the drain timeout is exactly 1.0 seconds, not 1200.
The production DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS constant remains 1200 and can be overridden per-test; test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS values take precedence over the suite baseline.
